📺 Vicente WON. You didn't see it — you had your own arena. The village will tell you about it for weeks.
📺 Prize for Vicente: the winner's share — alien rations for the pantry. The village eats tonight.

🕯️ Dominic Szymanski is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Dominic kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Dominic's gone." Omar looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Dominic." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Vicente blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Brawler's Instinct (Level 1). You read a fight as it moves. The body tells you what the mouth won't.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Dominic Szymanski, 86 days. The mantle passes to Vicente Moraes.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Vicente Moraes, 48 — a dockworker. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally.
The village's quarrel was with Dominic — and Dominic is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
You knew Dominic — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Vasyl, Omar, Elena speak for Vicente — "Dominic trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
